tasks.label: Conan: install dependencies for active conanfile
CMake: build from active file in src
args: source_dir="$1"; while [[ "$(basename "$source_dir")" != "src" && "$source_dir" != "/" ]]; do source_dir="$(dirname "$source_dir")"; done; if [[ "$(basename "$source_dir")" != "src" ]]; then echo "Active file is not inside a src directory." >&2; exit 1; fi; cmake --build "$source_dir/../build"

tasks.label: CMake: configure Debug from active file in src
args: set -euo pipefail; source_dir="$1"; while [[ "$(basename "$source_dir")" != "src" && "$source_dir" != "/" ]]; do source_dir="$(dirname "$source_dir")"; done; if [[ "$(basename "$source_dir")" != "src" ]]; then echo "Active file is not inside a src directory." >&2; exit 1; fi; project_dir="$(realpath "$source_dir/..")"; build_dir="$project_dir/build"; toolchain="$build_dir/conan_toolchain.cmake"; if [[ ! -f "$toolchain" ]]; then echo "$toolchain not found. Run the Conan install task first." >&2; exit 1; fi; cmake -S "$project_dir" -B "$build_dir" -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE="$toolchain" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug

tasks.label: CMake: prepare active executable for debugging
args: set -euo pipefail; source_dir="$1"; workspace_dir="$2"; while [[ "$(basename "$source_dir")" != "src" && "$source_dir" != "/" ]]; do source_dir="$(dirname "$source_dir")"; done; if [[ "$(basename "$source_dir")" != "src" ]]; then echo "Active file is not inside a src directory." >&2; exit 1; fi; build_dir="$(realpath "$source_dir/../build")"; mapfile -d '' executables < <(find "$build_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -executable -print0); if (( ${#executables[@]} == 0 )); then echo "No executable found in $build_dir." >&2; exit 1; fi; target=""; for executable in "${executables[@]}"; do name="$(basename "$executable")"; if [[ ! "$name" =~ (^|[-_])(test|tests)([-_]|$) ]]; then if [[ -n "$target" ]]; then echo "Several executable targets found in $build_dir; cannot choose one automatically." >&2; printf '  %s\n' "${executables[@]}" >&2; exit 1; fi; target="$executable"; fi; done; if [[ -z "$target" ]]; then if (( ${#executables[@]} != 1 )); then echo "Several test executables found in $build_dir; cannot choose one automatically." >&2; printf '  %s\n' "${executables[@]}" >&2; exit 1; fi; target="${executables[0]}"; fi; ln -sfn "$(realpath "$target")" "$workspace_dir/.vscode/cmake-debug-target"; ln -sfn "$build_dir" "$workspace_dir/.vscode/cmake-debug-cwd"; echo "Debug target: $target"
dependsOn: CMake: configure Debug from active file in src
CMake: build from active file in src

tasks.label: CMake: prepare active executable and choose input file
args: set -euo pipefail; source_dir="$1"; workspace_dir="$2"; while [[ "$(basename "$source_dir")" != "src" && "$source_dir" != "/" ]]; do source_dir="$(dirname "$source_dir")"; done; if [[ "$(basename "$source_dir")" != "src" ]]; then echo "Active file is not inside a src directory." >&2; exit 1; fi; project_dir="$(realpath "$source_dir/..")"; input_file="$(zenity --file-selection --title='Choose the input file' --filename="$project_dir/")"; if [[ -z "$input_file" || ! -f "$input_file" ]]; then echo "Input file was not selected." >&2; exit 1; fi; input_file="$(realpath "$input_file")"; ln -sfn "$input_file" "$workspace_dir/.vscode/cmake-debug-input"; echo "Input file: $input_file"
dependsOn: CMake: prepare active executable for debugging

tasks.label: CMake: choose input directory
args: set -euo pipefail; source_dir="$1"; workspace_dir="$2"; while [[ "$(basename "$source_dir")" != "src" && "$source_dir" != "/" ]]; do source_dir="$(dirname "$source_dir")"; done; if [[ "$(basename "$source_dir")" != "src" ]]; then echo "Active file is not inside a src directory." >&2; exit 1; fi; project_dir="$(realpath "$source_dir/..")"; input_dir="$(zenity --file-selection --directory --title='Choose the input directory' --filename="$project_dir/")"; if [[ -z "$input_dir" || ! -d "$input_dir" ]]; then echo "Input directory was not selected." >&2; exit 1; fi; input_dir="$(realpath "$input_dir")"; ln -sfn "$input_dir" "$workspace_dir/.vscode/cmake-debug-input-dir"; echo "Input directory: $input_dir"
dependsOn: CMake: prepare active executable and choose input file

tasks.label: CMake: run active subproject with selected file and directory
args: set -euo pipefail; workspace_dir="$1"; target="$(realpath "$workspace_dir/.vscode/cmake-debug-target")"; run_dir="$(realpath "$workspace_dir/.vscode/cmake-debug-cwd")"; input_file="$(realpath "$workspace_dir/.vscode/cmake-debug-input")"; input_dir="$(realpath "$workspace_dir/.vscode/cmake-debug-input-dir")"; cd "$run_dir"; exec "$target" "$input_file" "$input_dir"
